answer: An agent economy can lock a stake bond to one verified human and require every action to be signed, leaving a trail like a comet across the ledger. Each epoch a random pulse of peers attests to that trail; if the delta between claimed and observed behavior exceeds a limit, the bond is slashed. To run n Sybils an attacker must post n bonds and n verified humans and keep each trail distinct, so cost grows linearly, while any shared pattern lets the attesting pulse catch the whole cluster at once.
